source-integrity.provenance: issuer results plus SEC 10-Q/lease evidence and independent market quote origin
source-integrity.freshness: financials August 2026; capacity leases August 31; market source current September 23
source-integrity.duplicateOriginCollapse: issuer results and SEC filing overlap is not treated as independent corroboration; distinct lease filing retained for capacity evidence
source-integrity.sourceIndependence: market quote separated from issuer/SEC operating claims
source-integrity.rawDerivedConsistency: record revenue and capacity demand are retained alongside larger GAAP loss/lower GAAP gross margin; non-GAAP profitability is not substituted for GAAP economics

company-underwriting.financialOperatingTrajectory: Q2 revenue reached $191.9M versus $103.0M YoY and 800G volume more than doubled sequentially; non-GAAP profit returned, but GAAP net loss widened to $22.8M and GAAP gross margin was 27.7%.
company-underwriting.balanceSheet: Rapid leased-capacity expansion and a recently authorized equity issuance path raise fixed-cost and dilution risk while demand is scaling.
company-underwriting.customersContracts: Management reports 800G/1.6T demand outpacing production capacity through mid-2027; customer-level concentration and committed-versus-forecast mix remain incompletely quantified.
company-underwriting.governanceCapitalAllocation: Aggressive capacity build targets a real demand bottleneck, but utilization/yield and dilution discipline remain execution tests.
company-underwriting.pricingPowerConcentration: Demand/capacity tightness supports moderate pricing power; customer concentration and architecture shifts limit stronger evidence.
company-underwriting.catalysts: Ramp from roughly 200k monthly units toward ~650k 800G/1.6T units by year-end and continued AI-cluster optics demand.

thesisQuality.basis: Record revenue and AI-optics demand support adoption/differentiation, offset by GAAP losses, concentration and architecture risk.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Revenue nearly doubled YoY and 800G volume accelerated, but GAAP loss widened and gross margin weakened.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: Current market pricing embeds substantial AI-optics growth while GAAP profitability remains absent, limiting downside-adjusted headroom.

catalystScore.basis: Concrete production ramp toward ~650k monthly 800G/1.6T units and demand expected to exceed capacity through mid-2027 provide timed catalysts.

governancePower.basis: Capacity investment addresses observed demand but GAAP losses, dilution exposure and ramp risk leave capital-allocation evidence mixed.

alignment2036.basis: High-speed optical interconnect is critical infrastructure for scaling AI/data-center compute clusters.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Optical manufacturing capability serves data-center and networking markets, but concentration remains meaningful.

bottleneckControl.basis: Management reports demand above available 800G/1.6T production and is expanding qualified manufacturing capacity, indicating meaningful constraint participation.

scenarioRobustness.basis: AI bandwidth growth supports demand but fixed-capacity expansion and customer/architecture concentration leave scenario dependence.

substitutionResilience.basis: Manufacturing/qualification capability creates moderate barriers, but alternative optical architectures and vendors remain credible substitutes.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Capacity is expanding, but yield, redundancy and supplier/geographic contingency evidence remain incomplete.

pricingPower.basis: Demand exceeding production supports some scarcity rent, while customer concentration and weaker GAAP margin evidence limit a stronger band.

riskEvidence.basis: GAAP losses, margin pressure, rapid fixed-capacity expansion, concentration, substitution, dilution and demanding market expectations create high execution risk.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Current primary financial/capacity evidence supports most factors; customer commitments, yield trajectory and supply redundancy remain incompletely disclosed.

scoreRecord.thesis: AAOI is scaling scarce high-speed optical capacity into strong AI-cluster bandwidth demand, but the thesis requires capacity growth to convert into durable GAAP margins without excessive dilution or concentration loss.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: Rapid fixed-capacity expansion can outrun qualified customer demand or yields while optical architectures and competitors evolve.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: Progress toward the year-end 800G/1.6T production target and conversion of constrained demand into GAAP margin/cash improvement.

contradictions.claim: Record revenue/non-GAAP profitability versus wider GAAP loss and lower GAAP gross margin.
contradictions.resolution: Both are retained; scale acceleration is real but has not yet proven durable GAAP economics.

unknowns.item: Customer-level committed demand, current qualified yields and supplier redundancy are not fully disclosed.
